capabilities: Add comments to selected text via a selection toolbar
Render comment popups with Obsidian's native Markdown renderer
Highlight commented text with a configurable color
Relocate comments after note edits using text and context anchors
Manage, edit, or delete comments through a command palette action
disambiguation: Not a PDF/web annotation tool; it comments on text inside the vault's own notes in Reading view only.
extras: Manual installation only (no community plugin store install described); comments live in plugin data.json, so multi-device use requires syncing plugin data as well as notes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to attach non-destructive comments to note text without inserting HTML, markers, or hidden syntax into the Markdown source.
summary: Text-comment plugin that adds Markdown-rendered comments and highlights to selected text in Reading view, stored outside the notes.
